stories.title: Release of child killer in Victoria suspended after VicPD warning
stories.summary: Shane Ertmoed, 48, who killed 10-year-old Heather Thomas in Cloverdale in 2000, had been given a 60-day, unescorted temporary absence in the downtown area.

stories.title: Break in weather comes just in time for Santa Claus Parade in Victoria on Saturday
stories.summary: The 44th annual Santa Claus parade starts at 5:30 p.m. Saturday at Government and Belleville streets.

stories.title: Add your home or business to our map of holiday light displays
stories.summary: The Times Colonist Christmas Lights Map, which features the best holiday light displays in Greater Victoria, will appear in the Dec. 19 edition of the newspaper.

stories.title: Vancouver Whitecaps sweep Real Salt Lake, advance to MLS conference semifinals
stories.summary: Emmanuel Sabbi isn't used to playing striker for the Vancouver Whitecaps. He's generally slotted into the Major League Soccer team's lineup as a winger since joining the 'Caps back in February 2025.

stories.title: Nov. 28: Your Daily Horoscope
stories.summary: Saturday, November 28th ARIES (March 21 — April 20): Do opposites really attract? If they do you could find yourself aligned with someone you previously thought of as a rival and maybe even an enemy.

stories.title: Taiwan holds elections to choose mayors and other local leaders as China looks on
stories.summary: TAIPEI, Taiwan (AP) — Taiwan is choosing mayors, council members and other local leaders across its 22 cities and counties in an election Saturday that will test whether the ruling party can notch some wins at the local level.

stories.title: Kraken lean on special teams, timely goals to beat Oilers 4-2
stories.summary: EDMONTON — The Seattle Kraken haven’t had much success playing in Edmonton during their brief existence, but they finally found a way to leave the Alberta capital on a high note Friday.

stories.title: Barnes has 34 points as Raptors beat Nets 124-100 but are still bounced from NBA Cup
stories.summary: TORONTO — If the Toronto Raptors were disappointed to be bounced from the NBA Cup, they weren't going to show it.

stories.title: B.C. watchdog confirms probe into dramatic police-involved shooting death
stories.summary: RICHMOND — B.C.'s police watchdog says it's investigating a fatal police-involved shooting in Richmond, B.C., where video posted online appears to show an officer firing numerous shots from a rifle into a vehicle.

stories.title: Kakko scores twice in third as Kraken hand Oilers their fifth straight loss
stories.summary: EDMONTON — Kaapo Kakko scored two third-period goals two minutes apart as the Seattle Kraken rallied to beat the Edmonton Oilers 4-2 on Friday.

stories.title: Connor scores twice, Jets beat Islanders 3-1 for third straight win
stories.summary: NEW YORK (AP) — Kyle Connor had two goals and an assist and the Winnipeg Jets extended their winning streak to three games with a 3-1 victory over the New York Islanders on Friday night.

stories.title: Captain Bell and Goldeneyes hit the Island to wrap up training camp
stories.summary: PWHL team at Shawnigan Lake School Saturday through Monday
